# Vibe Apps

> The place to share and discover new apps. A public directory of apps built with Convex, vibe coding, and modern AI tools.

This GitHub copy is a pointer. The live, auto updating files are generated from public submissions (approved, not hidden, not spam):

- [llms.txt](https://vibeapps.dev/llms.txt)
- [vibeapps.md](https://vibeapps.dev/vibeapps.md)
- [sitemap.xml](https://vibeapps.dev/sitemap.xml)

## Site

- [Home](https://vibeapps.dev/): Browse the latest apps submitted by the community, vote, and comment.
- [Submit an app](https://vibeapps.dev/submit): Share what you have built with the Vibe Apps community.
- [Search](https://vibeapps.dev/search): Search apps, tags, and creators across the site.
- [Leaderboard](https://vibeapps.dev/leaderboard): Top apps and builders ranked by community votes and engagement.
